source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 478 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-478.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 478 was established by Ordinance No. 23168, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 11, 1997. Ordinance No. 23168 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 23168 was amended by Ordinance No. 23804, passed by the Dallas City Council on February 24, 1999. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 23168; 23804; 26042)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-478.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 478 is established on property generally located at the northeast corner of Interstate Highway 20 and Spur 408. The size of PD 478 is approximately 343.80 acres. (Ord. Nos. 23168; 26042)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-478.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations contained in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) In this article, PRIVATE RECREATION CENTER, CLUB, OR AREA means an area providing private recreational facilities such as playgrounds, parks, game courts, swimming pools, playing fields, and camping including cabins and other facilities to accommodate camping participants. This does not include a hotel or motel.

(c) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(d) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 23168; 26042)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-478.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 478A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development plan, the provisions of this article control. [Note: A new development plan (Exhibit 478B) was attached to Ordinance No. 23804 and is included in this article for reference.] (Ord. Nos. 23168; 23804; 26042)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-478.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Agricultural uses.

-- Crop production.

(b) Commercial and business service uses.

-- None permitted.

(c) Industrial uses.

-- None permitted.

(d) Institutional and community service uses.

-- Church. -- Library, art gallery, or museum.

(e) Lodging uses.

-- None permitted.

(f) Miscellaneous uses.

-- None permitted.

(g) Office uses.

-- None permitted.

(h) Recreation uses.

-- Private recreation center, club, or area.

(i) Residential uses.

-- None permitted.

(j) Retail and personal service uses.

-- None permitted.

(k) Transportation uses.

-- Transit passenger shelter.

(l) Utility and public service uses.

-- Electrical substation. [SUP] -- Local utilities. -- Tower/antenna for cellular communication. [SUP]

(m) Wholesale, distribution, and storage uses.

-- None permitted. (Ord. Nos. 23168; 26042)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-478.106. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to

additional regulations contained in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) The following accessory uses are not permitted in this PD:

-- Accessory helistop. -- Accessory medical/infectious waste incinerator. -- Accessory outside display of merchandise. -- Accessory outside sales. -- Accessory pathological waste incinerator. (Ord. Nos. 23168; 26042)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-478.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(a) Front, side, and rear yard.

(1) Except as provided in Paragraph (2) below, minimum front, side, and rear yard setbacks are as shown on the development plan.

(2) Minimum setback for structures from Kiwanis Road, Red Bird Lane, Cedar Ridge Drive, and the northern Property line is 75 feet.

(b) Floor area. Maximum floor area is 107,160 square feet. Structures must be located as shown on the development plan.

(c) Height. Maximum structure height is 24 feet, except for the climbing tower and flagpoles as shown on the development plan.

(d) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is as shown on the development plan.

(e) Lot size. No minimum lot size.

(f) Stories. Maximum number of stories above grade is two. (Ord. Nos. 23168; 23804; 26042)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-478.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) A total of 375 off-street parking spaces must be provided as shown on the development plan.

(b) Trails, drives, and parking must be provided as shown on the development plan and constructed to the following specifications as an alternative to those described in the Dallas Development Code.

(1) Parking.

(A) Administrative and service areas. Crushed rock, six inches in depth, compacted.

(B) Resident staff areas. Crushed rock, six inches in depth, compacted.

(C) Maintenance and storage areas. Crushed rock, six inches in depth, compacted.

(D) Staff dorm areas. Crushed rock, six inches in depth, compacted.

(E) Central public parking areas. Crushed rock, six inches in depth, compacted, with a two-inch asphalt surface.

(F) Other parking areas. Crushed rock, six inches in depth, compacted.

(2) Trails and drives.

(A) Entrance public road. Crushed rock, six inches in depth, compacted, with a three-inch asphalt surface.

(B) Service roads (10-inch width minimum). Crushed rock, six inches in depth, compacted.

(C) Trails. Natural surfaces.

(c) All paved areas, permanent drives, and streets must be completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 23168; 23804; 26042)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-478.109. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 23168; 26042)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-478.110. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Except as provided in Subsections (b) and (c) below, provisions contained in Article X apply to this district.

(b) With the exception of protected trees that are removed from any proposed building site which must be mitigated in accordance with Article X, protected trees within the area designated as the Proposed Lake on the development plan must be mitigated by the annual planting of a minimum of 3,500 seedings or trees per year for a minimum period of 10 years. Trees or seedings used for the Proposed Lake area mitigation shall have no minimum caliper inch. Mitigation required by Article X does not apply to protected trees that are removed for any proposed vehicular access shown on the development plan, including driveways.

(c) A minimum of one Carolina Jasmine or one Trumpet Vine must be planted for each 10 linear feet along the outside of the perimeter fence as shown on the development plan adjacent to Red Bird Lane and Cedar Ridge Road.

(d) All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 23168; 26042)

sections.title: Fencing
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-478.111. FENCING.

Perimeter fencing must be provided as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 23168; 26042)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-478.112. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 23168; 26042)

sections.title: Lighting
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-478.113. LIGHTING.

All outdoor lighting must be operational and maintained in accordance with the Dallas Development Code, and must be directed away from adjoining properties. (Ord. Nos. 23168; 26042)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-478.114. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23168; 26042)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-478.115. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23168; 26042)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-478.116. ZONING MAP.

PD 478 is located on Zoning Map Nos. O-3 and O-4. (Ord. Nos. 23168; 26042)
